title: WARD Entry
description: A single ward entry (v0.2). A content-free hash-chain receipt witnessing a source event. See SPEC.md section 6.

ward_version.description: Protocol version, e.g. "0.2". Selects the chain-hash scheme (SPEC.md section 16.1): "0.2" canonical-JSON hash body, "0.1" legacy concatenation (verify-only).

ward_entry_id.description: Unique identifier for this entry within the chain

chain_id.description: Identifier for the chain this entry belongs to. For ward_version 0.2 and later it MUST NOT contain the reserved "::" sequence (SPEC.md section 5.2); v0.1 entries predate that rule and a violation warns instead (SPEC.md Appendix A).

seq.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number, starting at 1

witnessed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with UTC Z suffix — when WARD observed the source event

source_kind.description: The kind of source event being witnessed

source_id.description: Identifier of the source event. For WARD meta-chain entries, format is <chain_id>::<tip_seq>

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the source event's canonical content

prev_chain_hash.description: Previous entry's chain_hash, or genesis_hash for seq=1

chain_hash.description: This entry's computed chain hash: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the 10 required fields excluding chain_hash itself (see SPEC.md section 4.4; legacy v0.1 scheme in Appendix A)

issuer_id.description: Identifier of the WARD instance that created this entry

source_ts.description: ISO 8601 timestamp from the source event itself (optional)

tags.description: String tags for filtering and categorization

source_id.description: Meta-chain reference: <sub_chain_id>::<tip_seq>. The sub-chain id contains no "::" (single colons allowed), so splitting on the first "::" is unambiguous; tip_seq is a positive decimal integer.

then.description: Per-entry signature verification is implementation-defined in v0.2; a sig without a resolvable key identifier is an annotation, not evidence.
